name: Seed Junky Prepackaged Flower | Bonfire
description: Bonfire is a balanced hybrid that delivers a bright, clear-headed lift paired with a smooth sense of calm. Notes of tropical fruit blend with refreshing cool mint and subtle earthy spice, creating a flavorful smoke that feels both uplifting and grounding. The experience provides an elevated mood while maintaining a relaxed, comfortable body feel, making it perfect for afternoon sessions or easygoing social moments.
